title: Fix Warp Happy Path and Visuals
description: Fix the critical bugs in the inter-system warp flow to enable a successful transition between systems without errors or rendering issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Warp flow A\u2192B: client plays warp-in, sends 'warp', server moves ship, client swaps world and plays warp-out, ending in the target system
No loading screen: the 'black screen' failure in e2e (pixel-variance check) is fixed; WarpOverlay.tsx is correctly rendered and visible during transition
World swap: 'Star not found' error in WorldManager.loadWorld is resolved; the target system's star and planet are rendered correctly (verified by e2e screenshot diff)
e2e (TASK-70): basic warp flow tests in app/tests/e2e/warp.spec.ts pass

steps.details: Investigate app/src/shared/galaxy/system.ts and app/src/client/world/WorldManager.ts to resolve the 'Star with ID ... not found in galaxy generated with seed' error. Ensure seed-based system generation is consistent between server and client.

Debug app/tests/e2e/warp.spec.ts failure at line 72 (pixel variance check). Verify that WarpOverlay.tsx animations are rendering on top of the canvas and not being blocked or resulting in a clear-canvas/black-frame.
Run 'cd app && npm run test:e2e' and ensure the basic warp transition from one system to another completes successfully without errors and matches the expected visual baseline.

technicalNotes: Picks up from previous attempts where server crashes were fixed and atomic world swap was implemented in WorldManager.ts.
The working tree has uncommitted changes in app/src/server/shard/shard.ts and app/src/client/world/WorldManager.ts that should be reviewed/committed first.
The focus is on the 'Happy Path' (A\u2192B warp). Edge cases (system full, disconnects) are deferred to TASK-8.2.
E2E tests are located in app/tests/e2e/warp.spec.ts and must be run from the app/ directory.
